transformation: Given a set of transaction statistics from TxLINE, construct a Merkle tree where leaves are individual statistical values, generate a Merkle proof for a specific stat against a canonical root, and verify the proof on-chain using Solana's native signature verification or a dedicated program.
constraints: Root must be anchored on Solana

mechanism: Cross-Program Constraint Solver for Transaction Validation
transformation: Formulate a constraint satisfaction problem over attributes of TxLINE transactions, invoke the validate_stat program via CPI with a constraint set, and use the returned pass/fail status to conditionally execute further programmable logic on Solana.
constraints: CPI must adhere to Solana compute budget

mechanism: Live Data Stream Anomaly Detection via Rolling Merkle Roots
transformation: Continuously compute Merkle trees over sliding windows of TxLINE transaction statistics, compare consecutive roots or against a reference model (e.g., previous window root, statistical norm), and flag anomalies when dissimilarity exceeds a threshold; on-chain verification uses stored roots.
constraints: Root storage on Solana must not exceed account size limits

mechanism: Provenance Tracking for Composite Statistics via CPI Audit Trails
transformation: When deriving a composite statistic from raw TxLINE transactions, wrap each transformation step (filter, aggregate, join) in a CPI call that logs input hashes, output hash, and validator signature on Solana, creating an immutable, verifiable audit trail of the derivation.
constraints: Solana account size and rent limits
CPI depth must not exceed maximum
